name: prestashopheaven/build-rules-core
description: Core of the Module-Factory rules registry: the rule schema, the loader that reads every rules package, the stage filter, the conventions.md generator and the ps-module rules command.

prestashopheaven.use-when: When a stage of the Module-Factory needs its rules as a checklist (ps-module rules stage <stage>), when a rule is added or changed (edit the JSON, then ps-module rules generate), or to check that every rule has a stage and a check.
